summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting FDA approval of the company's drug VEPPANU (vepdegestrant) for ER+/HER2- breast cancer. The press release notes the milestone payment of $50 million from collaborator Pfizer and a contingent payment owed to Yale. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. The disclosure is a routine regulatory and business update on product approval, not a special situation as defined.
